233)dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar rta mchog dpal/'chol ba

tei:div.tei:p: dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar rta mchog dpal/ 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po'i dmod pa'i thog log 'dren dgra bgegs snying la 'bebs pa'i slad/ mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po spro/ de la 'dir dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas las rim mtha' sdud mnan pa'i phrin las bya ba la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis gtan la 'bebabs te/ de yang sngon 'gro bca' shom gyi rim pa logs su 'chad pa la shes par byas nas/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i gzhung la 'jug pa ni/ ji skad du/ dang po sngags pa bskyed pa rdzogs pa yis: zhes dang*/ rgyud bzhi'i dbang thob dam tshig dang ldan pas: zhes gsungs pas/ de'ang yi dam 'di'i snyen sgrub las gsum tshad du 'khyol pa'am/ min na'ang yid dam gang rung la snyen pa them zhing 'di'i dbang lung man ngag nod pa'i sngags pas drag po'i las la shis pa'i gnas su dmar phyogs kyi gza' tshes dus sbyor shin tu rtsub cing bdud nyi nag la yung gsum lcag khams kyi lo zla nyi khyim sogs spyi dang bye brag dmigs bya'i lo zla zhag dus kyi log sbyor rtsub mos dgra bor gyim shang gnad du phrad pa'i dus tshod de/ gang gi tshe na'ang snying rje khros pa'i zhe sdang 234) 'gog tu med pa'i gnas skabs su rtsom dgos pa ni/ ji skad du/ zhe sdang mang yal mthu yi mchog ces pa bzhin bshad ma thag pa'i stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang las ldang ba'i gnad ma shes na mngon pa'i nga rgyal che tsam la dgos pa med de/ gter khyim du/ lta ba rtogs shing snying rjes bsgral ba gces: zhe sdang rang mthu srin po'i mthu: phyi ma ngan song du ltung ngo: zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don blo la ma chud na/ sngags chung mthu skad can la'ang las 'bras kyi rnam smin dang phyi ma'i phebs lam spyi mthun nyag gcig tu gyur pa'ang bsams nas/

bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i bar sngon du grub rjes/ thugs dam skul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skuḥ sogs gzhung ltar dang*/ spro na/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lhaḥ dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen pos nasaḥ 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcasaḥ dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzodaḥ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyangaḥ gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i chad lugs rdzogs mdzad paḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs 235) zhi khro dngaḥ dbang drag padma'i lha tshogs thugs dam canaḥ mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs thugs dam bskulaḥ drag po'i phris mdzad pa'i dus la babasaḥ thugs dam thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrolaḥ zhes bskul lo/ de nas gser skyems bshams laḥ rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud ma'i 'phros dkar nag bden rdzun gyi shan 'byed mkhyen gsol ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang nas bzung steḥ dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod duḥ sangs rgyas dngos dang snyan brgyud ma chad pa'iḥ rgyal ba dgongs rgyud rig 'dzin brda brgyud dngaḥ gang zag snyan brgyud snyan gson cigaḥ gsang sngags bla med dgongs pa snying po'i donaḥ 'khor 'das byang chub sems su ro gcig pasaḥ 'od gsal thig le chen po'i ngang nyid lasaḥ rigs can rnams kyis smin grol byed pa laḥ dam nyams zhing bcu rnams kyi ma ster roḥ rig 'dzin bla mas gzu dang dpang mdzod cigaḥ dbyings dang ye shes dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdagaḥ rigs lnga rigs gsum dus gsum 236) rgyal dang srasaḥ yon tan phrin las ma lus 'dus pa'i skuḥ zhi khro rab 'byams grub pa bka' brgyad dngaḥ rdo rje gro lod bsnyon cing bsgrubs pa'i lhaḥ las dang ye shes mkha' 'gro snyan gson cigaḥ bla ma mchog mjal dbang bskur man ngag zhusaḥ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bskyed rdzogs zab ma brtenaḥ

bde gshegs bka' bzhin bsgrub sems rnal 'byor bdagaḥ bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di yis sems dkrugs soḥ yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang mdzod cigaḥ kun tu bzang mo spyan dang mā ma kiḥ gos dkar sgrol ma rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro maḥ gnas dang yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'grau dngaḥ sprul dang yang sprul ma sring rgya mtsho dngaḥ dur khrod brgyad kyi mkha' 'grau snyan gson cigaḥ sbas mtha' nags 'dabs gnas dang dur khrod duḥ lhag pa'i sems la sbyar ba'i brtul zhugs kyisaḥ zhi gnas lhag mthong nyams rtogs sgom pa laḥ phung byed dam nyams 'di yis ma ster roḥ sngags srung dam can rgya mtsho 237) dregs pa'i tshogasaḥ dpa' bo mrod gzu dang dpang mdzod cigaḥ chos longs sprul skus stong dang rten cing 'brelaḥ zung 'jug rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i chos bstan paḥ gdul bya'i bsam pas theg pa grub mtha'i sgoḥ mtha' yas du mar go yang ngo bo gcigaḥ kun la ris med dag snang rtsal sbyangs shingaḥ bdag bsto gzhan smod chags sdang tsher ma spangasaḥ rang gis tshul bzhin dam chos spyod sems laḥ ban dgra bon dgra nag po'i 'tshe ba dang: rang zas sman la gzhan zas dug ltar bltasaḥ dman pa'i sa bzung kha nyan dpung pa smadaḥ mtho la ma smad dma' la ma brnyas shingaḥ bar du phrag dog ru nga'i sbyor spangs kyangaḥ bstan pa'i ru tra nag po glang snying 'disaḥ spyir ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yongs la 'tsheḥ sgos su dpal mgon bla mas thugs rgyud dkrugasaḥ yang sgos bdag cag chos srid bstan pa laḥ bden pa khyad 238) gsod ma rung khong bsran bcasaḥ ngor rtsub ma bde thabs kyis mtha' nas skulaḥ rang nus ma thon log 'dren gzhan bdag rbodaḥ kha dkar zhe gnag mgo rmod rgab nas rtsubaḥ ma byas byas dang ma byung byung zhes pa'iḥ legs bsub nyes sgrog ya ga ngan smas sbyoraḥ rgyab nas 'dod cing mdun nas sgug pa dngaḥ zur nas gsod gcod brku 'phrog rdeg byed cingaḥ rang gi chos srid 'byor pas mi ngoms pasaḥ

gzhan la la phrag dog bstan la bsnyengs pa yiḥ phyi dgra zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba dngaḥ nang dgra bsam ngan rlung ltar 'tshubs pa yiḥ snga dgra nyes byed chu ltar rgyug pa dngaḥ phyis dgra byed sems dug ltar khong ltar g.yoḥ da dgra drag po tsher ltar rtsub pa yiḥ byad ma dgra bo phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyangaḥ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa tshul 'dzin pa'iḥ bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho dregs pa'i 'khoraḥ bstan dang bstan 'dzin 239) rnal 'byor la dung pa'iḥ rngam drag 'bar ba dpal gyi pho nya rnamasaḥ rgyal ba'i bka' dang rnal 'byor dam bzhin 'dusaḥ nyes byed dgra bo'i gzugs phung rnam shes bcasaḥ pha tshan yul 'khor mi nor sde dpung rnamasaḥ rang dbang med par drag po'i rten la phobasaḥ zhes skyems gshegs shing spros pa chung skabs gzhung gi gzu dpang gis kyang 'thus so// brub khung bskyed pa ni eḥ bdag nyid che mchog padmar gsal ba yiḥ thugs nas mthing nag e yig chad pa lasaḥ yongs gyur gnod byed dgra bgegs brub pa'i khungaḥ gnam lcags las grub btson khang zur gsum paḥ zin nas thar pa med pa mun pa'i glingaḥ steng nas 'dab chags sha zan klad na ldingaḥ 'og phyogs 'dod chags khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugaḥ nang dmar zhe sdang rang bzhin me dpung 'baraḥ phyi nag gti mug mun pa sprin ltar thibaḥ khor yug lcag sregs gzhir shan pa'i grongaḥ rtsang 240) dmar las byed gshin rje'i pho nya'i tshogasaḥ nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor bcas gsal bar gyuraḥ ces brub khung pho nya dang bcas pa gsal btab nas dmigs bya rgyal 'debs ni/ hṛ triḥ de nang bkod pa'i liṅga bsgral ba'i zhingaḥ bstan pa spyi dang rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgraḥ dam nyams gnod byed dgra bgegs a mu kaḥ gzugs brnyan ri mor bris la ming byang btabaḥ rnam shes rten dang bcas pa zag rdzas byugasaḥ nyams thag mya ngan 'dug stangs rkang lag bcingasaḥ mngon sum lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyuraḥ ces dngos su bsam/

de nas 'gugs 'dren bya ba ni/ na moḥ rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i lhaḥ mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dam can srung mar bcasaḥ sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzinaḥ dkon mchog gsum sogs bka' yi bden pa dngaḥ khyad par dbang chen rdo rje gro bo lodaḥ las kyi mtha' sdud 'chi bdag ma he'i gdongaḥ bla 'gugs phon pa pho mo sprul 'khor bcasaḥ dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bden pa'i 241) mthusaḥ bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang bstan 'dzin dmodaḥ khyad par sngags 'chang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdagaḥ rgyu sbyor bsrung bya mi nor 'khor bcas laḥ snga dgra lag brdar phyi dgra yid la semasaḥ da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs: dur sri phung sri god sri chung sri dngaḥ pho sri mo sri mtshon sri dgra sri sogasaḥ kha 'jam gting rtsub zhe nas dmod pa dngaḥ do bsdo phod 'jug bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byedaḥ mi lha lha med lha la mthu med cesaḥ mthu dang nus pa bu lon bzhin du gsheraḥ 'gro lam rtsang 'jug za lam dug sbyor bshamasaḥ dmigs yul gzugs ling bkod pa 'di rnams kyiḥ rnam shes bla tshe srog dang bcas pa rnamasaḥ gnam sa gling bzhi gling phran ri rab gsengaḥ nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i skyabasaḥ gang na gnas kyang liṅga 'di nyid laḥ khug cig badzra aṅgu sha ya dzaḥ ske nas chings shig badzra pa sha hūm̐ḥ yan lag sdoms shig badzra spho 242) ṭa bam̐ḥ myos par gyis shig badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ lha dang phyes shig pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ dbyer med stims shig a be sha ya aḥ zhes 'gugs 'ching sdom myos dbye bstim gyi phyag rgya dang dmigs gnad nan gtan bskyed de 'gugs zhugs rol mo'i 'tshams rngam bshugs sgra dang bcas bya/ slar gzhung gi 'gugs pa brgya'am nyer gcig gam bdun la sogs dngos nyams dang sbyar zhing gu gul nag pos bdug pho nya skul ba na/ hūm̐ḥ bskal pa chen po brgyad khri yiḥ bzhi stong 'khor ba'i gzhal yas nasaḥ

lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug giḥ 'bar ba'i dbus phyogs rngam pa nasaḥ 'aubs chen bcu gnyis gting mtha' medaḥ thod mkhar 'bar ba'i nang zhig naḥ pho brang sgo khar spu gris gtamasaḥ klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stengaḥ lto 'phye phyogs skyong ma he'i khriḥ thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan steng nasaḥ srog bdud tshe bdag nag po bzhengs: rngam pa'i tshul gyis bla 'gugs rnams: da lta khyed kyi las 243) la khyeḥ dzaḥ shar gyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs paḥ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgoḥ lho yi phyogs nas bla 'gugs paḥ lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgoḥ nub kyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs paḥ bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgoḥ byang gi phyogs nas bla 'gugs paḥ gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgoḥ bla rkun mon pa khyed bzhi yang: dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangasaḥ phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsitta dguḥ zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la rgyugaḥ spyan dgus dgra bgegs bsal nas 'dzinaḥ snying dgus dgra bgegs yid la byedaḥ phyag dgus dgra bgegs tsitta 'byinaḥ zhal dgus kha mkhar mder gsolaḥ ljags dgus myos pa'i khrag mtsho 'thungaḥ dgra bgegs myur du khrid la shogaḥ dzaḥ shar phyogs dri za me lha'i gtsoḥ he le khyab pa gtum chen 'jomasaḥ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogasaḥ dzaḥ lho phyogs gshin rje srin po'i gtsoḥ nag po 'dzum med 244)gtum chen 'jomasaḥ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogasaḥ nub phyogs chu dbang rlung lha'i gtsoḥ nag po bkrag med chags med 'jomasaḥ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogasaḥ dzaḥ byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'byung po'i gtsoḥ so 'dar khrig pa khrag chen posaḥ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogasaḥ bhyaḥ dpal gyi phyag brnyan rakta'i dri bsnams maḥ khrag mdog dmar po bse yi ral pa canaḥ sder mo lcags kyu'i rtse la rakta'i me 'bar maḥ nyams pa'i snying phyung mchan khung chug la shogaḥ khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa khaḥ

rgyug pa'i stabs ni spyang mo ngar ma 'draḥ drag po'i skad ni nam mkha'i 'brug las cheḥ rgyug pa'i stobs ni bar snang glog las mgyogasaḥ zangs kyi sder mo dmar po'i changs pa ruḥ mgon med byi phrug sha rjen bcug pa ltaraḥ dam nyams dgra bo'i don snying phyungs la shogaḥ rnam smin phung po dum bur gtubs la shogaḥ gzugs kyi phung po de ru 245) zhog la shogaḥ rnam par shes pa 'di ru khyer la shogaḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed aṅku sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes rol mo tsham rngam kyis drag tu bskul la g.yab dar g.yob cing 'od zer 'phro 'du dang pho nyas bkug: bla 'gugs kyi sngags ni/ hūm̐ badzra shri gro bo lod dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ nṛ tri aṃ gu sha dza dzaḥ bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grimaḥ sha ma ru ti thuṃ thuṃḥ myog myogaḥ yed yedaḥ sha ma ru ti khug khugaḥ ling mgyogasaḥ ling shagaḥ ling thuṃ: tsa munt+ri dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes gzhung las 'byung ba dang*/ hṛ sha ku ru kha so pa tiḥ kha ti pa tiḥ yaṃ ru tiḥ yaṃ se na yaṃ se naḥ me na yaṃḥ snying tshal sa rbadaḥ baṃ ri li rbadaḥ dam nyams dgra bgegs khyod kyi bla rten tshe rten srog rten ci yod pa thams cad 'dir khug myur du shog cigaḥ ces bla 'gugs pa'i rtags ma byung bar du bzla'oḥ gal te khugs pa'i mtshan ma shin tu thal na/ dmigs pa drag tu gzhur zhing bla 'gugs kyi pho nya mon mo'i tshogs dang khyi 'gyed sogs rbad pa med par khug pa ni/ ji skad du/ las kyi pho nya 'di dag niḥ bskul 246) dang rbad pas srid gsum rjoms ཿ las bsgrub the tshom med par ngesaḥ zhes gsungs kyang 'dir re zhig de tsam mo/ de yang 'gugs pa'i dus gnad ni/ dmigs bya rang rang la bla rgyud dus mi 'dra ba re re sogs zab gnad mang du gsungs kyang 'dir rgyas bshad dor ba'i/ ji skad du/ snga dro stag mo langs pa'i dus dang niḥ nyin dung khyim bya gdang la nyal ba dngaḥ srod la srin mo lto la rngam pa'i dusaḥ

khyad par nyi ma grib so 'jug dus dngaḥ zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don gtso bor bzung nas/ tho rengs/ gung gnyis/ shar nub kyi grib so byung skabs/ srod gdong nag dus te drug goḥ rgyas bsdus kyi go skabs rig pa'i mda' mo 'phen par bya'oḥ skabs su rigs mthun gyi gzhung gzhan las byung ba'i zab gnad 'di yang bya ste/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ da ni dgra bo sgrol ba'i dus la babaḥ da ni nam gyi srod la bab dus 'diraḥ chom rkun las la 'gyed pa'i dus yin pasaḥ dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'khyams pa'i dusaḥ dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shogaḥ bhyoḥ da lta nam gyi gung la bab dus 'diraḥ sems med 'byung ba chu yang gnyid log giḥ dgra 247) bo las ngan sdig can gnyid log giḥ bla tshe 'khyams bo da lta khrid la shogaḥ bhyoḥ da lta nam gyi tho rangs bab dus 'diraḥ dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo ba'i dusaḥ las ngan bla 'khyams myur du khrid la shogaḥ bhyoḥ da ni nam langs nyi ma shar dus 'diraḥ mi phyugs thams cad las la gram pa'i dusaḥ dgra bo'i bla tshe sgo ru thon pa'i dusaḥ bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shogaḥ bhyoḥ da lta nyi ma'i gung la bab dus 'diraḥ dgra bo'i rnam shes byings shing myos pa'i dusaḥ dgra bo'i bla tshe 'thom zhing 'khyams pa'i dusaḥ bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shogaḥ bhyoḥ da ni nyi nub grib so phog pa'i dusaḥ snying mi dga' zhing shes pa 'phyo ba'i dusaḥ dgra bo'i bla tshe rnam shes 'phyo ba'i dusaḥ bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shogaḥ

ces dang rang rang gi dus dang bstun pa'i bskul pa'am yang na mthar chags su bya'o/ de nas rgyab brten 248) gyi lha dang phra ba ni gu gul gyi bdug bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgro gnyis kyis g.yab cing*/ spro na dgra bo'i lha lnga ming rus dang bcas pa'i bar du ma mo'i sngags byang gtem la sgro yis gnan cing dbye rdzas dmigs bsal gyis bdug pa dang bskul byang sogs gud las byung ba ltar 'dir yang sems so// hūm̐ḥ sdig can dgra bo las ngan 'diḥ dgra lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phrolaḥ srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phrolaḥ zhang lha lte ba'i khung nas phrolaḥ ma lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrolaḥ pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phrolaḥ mo lha phrag pa g.yon nas phrolaḥ bang lha mdzod khang nang nas phrolaḥ ban bon la sogs 'go ba'i lhaḥ rig 'dzin la sogs srung ba'i lhaḥ ma lus rgyab nas phrol nas shogaḥ hūm̐ḥ las byed pho nya thams cad dngaḥ bdag gi srung ma dam can rnamasaḥ dgra bo'i lha lnga dbang du sdusaḥ dgra bo'i yul lha mnol du chugasaḥ dgra bo'i pho nya gyes su chugasaḥ dgra lha pham zhing 'thor 249) du chugasaḥ mo lha mo sman yar du chugasaḥ dgra bo lha dang phrol la shogaḥ bdag gi grogs byed dam can rnamasaḥ nyes byas dam nyams dgra bo 'di'iḥ mgon byed ma lha dbang du sdusaḥ srung byed srog lha dbang du sdusaḥ le'u dgu'i lha srung byad du phobasaḥ phan byed zhang lha dbang du sdusaḥ mgon byed yul lha dbang du sdusaḥ mtshon byed pho lha dbang du sdusaḥ skyob byed dgra lha dbang du sdusaḥ hūm̐ḥ kha kha mu kha mthu mo cheḥ mthing nag chen mo bya rog dbuḥ rtog med zas su sha la zaḥ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babaḥ hu lu mu kha mthu mo cheḥ ser nag chen po 'ug pa'i dbuḥ khyod ni nyin mtshan med par rgyugaḥ khyod gyi thugs dam dus la babaḥ dgra dang dgra lha phrol la shogaḥ lus dang srong ma phrol la shogaḥ khyo dang chung ma phrol la shogaḥ gnyen dang nye du phrol la shogaḥ

phu bo nu bo phrol la shogaḥ 250) mngon spyaud drag pos rdul du rlogasaḥ a nṛ tri trag rakṣa ma ra ya phye phyeḥ ma ma trag ru tra mā ra ya phyeḥ zhes nan tsam re bzlas pas lha dang dbye'o// pha rol po lha srung bzang na lha lnga dkrog pa'i drag sngags gzhung las 'byung ba ltar bya'o// de nas dngos nyams rmi lam gyi sgo nas bla drags mthong ba dngaḥ de nyid gang du brdzu ba der mngag pa'i pho nya rbad dgos pa'angaḥ re zhig 'dir ma spros pas bstan don gal che'i rigs la logs su shes par bya'o// de ltar zhag grangs ji ltar yang khug pa'i rtags mthong na bsad pa'i las la 'jug dgos te/ slob dpon chen pos nas bla ma khug bar las la sbyar ba ni dgra bo med par mtshon cha rdeg pa dang 'draḥ bla khugs nas las la ma sbyar na sku rwa nas dgra bo shor ba dang 'draḥ zhes sogs skyon yon gyi rnam grangs shin tu mang bar gsungs pas bsad pa'am las la sbyar ba ni thun snod g.yag rgod kyi rwa g.yas me chus ma phog pa'i nang du thun rdzas tshang ba shog gu'am g.yag rngas bkab pas mdun du bshams la/ e dzaḥbhyoḥ thun snod nad mtshon dug rlangs phog pa'i klongaḥ thun rdzas las byed pho nya za gsod rngamaḥ gtum drag rgyob sod 'jigs pa'i 'brug stong ldiraḥ stong khams gang ba'i mtshon 251) cha thog ltar 'bebasaḥ log 'dren gnad la dbab pa'i mthu ldan gyuraḥ ces gzi byin bskyed la/ dmigs gnad ni drag sngags mtshon cha'i 'od zer lasaḥ shugs ldan ri chen nyil ltar 'phrosaḥ sha za gsod byed pho nya bskulaḥ kho yi ba spu'i bu gar gdabaḥ sogs gnam lcags 'khor lo bsnol ma shugs drag tu bskor dmigs kyis rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i dmigs gnad zab mo zhal las shes par byas nas bzla bya'i sngags ni rtsa sngags gsham du/ oṃ āḥ.uṣṇi ṣa ya rbadaḥ yan tra tsakra rbadaḥ man tra ya tsa ma rbadaḥ zhes dang zab gnad che na sngags rtsang gsham du gzhung gi dam sri shi sa bstan pa'i sngags rgod kyang bzla zhing mchil rlangs ma shor ba'i gnad dang ldan pas thun la rang blud nas ling ga la thun gyis brab cing bskul pa ni/

hūm̐ḥ nga ni rdo rje gro bo lodaḥ dgra dang bgegs kyi gnyen po steḥ yungs dkar rgyal po sha ri raṃḥ dgra bgegs steng du brab par byaḥ khrag thun dug rlangs chi li liḥ mtsho dbal mda' 'phen zangs se zangaḥ gnam lcags thog chen hri li liḥ yungs dkar rbab 'dril sha ra raḥ phung po'i steng du brab par byaḥ 252) dzaḥm ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa la trig nanaḥ e hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad sodaḥ ces dang spro na gzhung gi drang srong dmod pa dang*/ 'bod nas 'byung ba'i lo dang zla ba la sogs kyang rjod/ de nas bsad rtags kyi drod tshad shes par bya dgos te/ snga ma'i 'phro las gsod pa'i nang rtags med par mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum byas na dgra mi 'chi'oḥ zhes dang*/ bsad las tshad las thal na rang nyid grir 'chi/ drod tshad mkhas na mda' dang 'dra'oḥ zhes gsungs pas so/ de phyir sod rtags mngon gyur nasaḥ mnan pa'i las sgrub ni gzhung gzhan las gnas lngar gnam lcags tsakra niḥ sgul spyod mi nus mnan par sgomasaḥ zhes gsungs pas/ dmigs pa gsal 'debs niḥ dgra bgegs byung po'i spyi mgrin snying ga steḥ gsang gnas gnam lcag tsakra rtsibs bzha ི paḥ gnam lcags rdo rjes mtshon dang tshigs chen bzhiraḥ rgya gram lci zhing 'thas dang rig sngags kyiḥ dmod pas mnan pas sgo gsum rmongs shing 'thibaḥ bsgul bskyod smra bsam med pa nyid du gyuraḥ ces dmigs pa gsal pos/ rtsa sngags gsham du/ oṃ āḥ 253) uṣṇa ṣaḥ du na sa du naḥ eka du naḥ she du nanaḥ baṃ nir hūm̐ laṃ st+wam bha ya nanaḥ zhes dmigs rtags dang ma ldan bar du bsgrubaḥ de ltar 'gugs bsad mnan gsum gyi thun mtshams kun tu dmar gtor ba la dang raktas bran par dmigs nas/ na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs 'gug gzhug gi mthar sman raka bran la/ dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ngo bo rang gzhin rnam par dag cing rmad du byung ba las rnam pa dgra bo'i sha khrag gi rang bzhin yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs dang srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i dgyes skong dam par gyuraḥ

oṃ āḥhūm̐: e a ra li hring hring dza dzaḥ gsum gyis rlobasaḥ hūm̐ḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa bdud kyi tshogasaḥ sde dpung 'khor bcas pa yiḥ sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'diḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bulaḥ las dang bag chags dag pa dngaḥ rang gshed bsam sbyor ngan pa rnamasaḥ kho rang la ni zlog pa dngaḥ rang mtshon rang la zug pa dngaḥ rang sha rang gis za bar mdzodaḥ 254) rang sde rang gis phye mar thongasaḥ rdul cha tsam yang med par mdzodaḥ hūm̐ḥ gtum chen 'bar ba khro bo'i rjeḥ dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lodaḥ rta mchog rol pa sras dang 'khoraḥ 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i nga ro yisaḥ dgra bgegs gnad nas 'gugs pa dngaḥ bdag srung rkyen ngan bar chad zlogaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces gtor ma 'bul/ de ltar thun gyi dngos gzhi 'gugs bsad mnan gsum gyi rtags rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ las mtha' bsdu ba ni/ gzhung gi tshogs mchod bakhrags pa'i bar grub rjes/ rang nyid che mchog padma drag po'i 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho rngam stobs rings shing khros pas rmongs 'ching gi las mdzad par bsam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ 'gugs bsad mnan gsum gyi sngags sbrel nas zla bzhin du liṅga brub khung nas phyungs te mdun du bkod nas/ rang grib phar 'chol ba dang ling grib tshur mi 'go ba'i thabs kyang gzhung gzhan nas byung ba ltar byas nas/ thugs dam bskul zhing gzu dpang dang*/ 'gugs gzhug drag po lan gsum gyi mthar gu gul gyis bdug bhyoḥ las byed phra man sogs/ bsdu na 255) dzñā na a yu she pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ ces rjod/ slob dpon gyis thun rdzas thogs pa rdeg cing dmod mo bya ba ni/ hoḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo 'disaḥ sngags 'chang bdag la rgol ba dngaḥ yi dam lha la phod btsugs pasaḥ gzugs phung shig la tshe srog phrogasaḥ yas nas steng gi 'ju thag chodaḥ 'og nas sa yi rten phur phyungasaḥ bar du rlung rta'i mkhar po shigasaḥ drang srong dmod pa'i bka' chad phobasaḥ

skye mched ma lus 'gags su chugasaḥ rten 'brel bcu gnyis bdud du phobasaḥ dug lnga'i rang mtshang khong nas shigasaḥ mi nor ma lus phyags mas thobasaḥ dus la bab po sa ma yaḥ zhes dang hūm̐ḥ dpal chen gsang ba'i bka' las niḥ zhes pa nas/ badzra sarba duṣṭan trig nanaḥ zhes pa'i bar gzhung ltar rjod/ phur pa thogs la/ hūm̐ḥ hūm̐ las byung ba'i sgrol ging niḥ thung la sbom zhing gsus pa cheḥ 'od zer bskal pa'i me dpung bzhinaḥ dug gsum sreg byed kī la 256) yaḥ he ru ka yi spyan snga ruḥ ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas paḥ dkon mchog bla ma brnyes byed paraḥ dus la bab po kī la yaḥ sku stod zhal gcig phyag gnyis paḥ g.yas pa ral gri nam mkhar 'phyaraḥ g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang gsolaḥ dam nyams snying la kī la yaḥ sku smad phur bu zur gsum dbalaḥ blo ldan rdo rje tho ba yisaḥ gnas bcu rnams su gdab par byaḥ oṃ gha ghaḥ gha ta ya gha ta yaḥ sarba duṣṭan ma ra ya phaṭaḥ kī la yaḥ kī la yaḥ sarba pā paṃḥ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badzra kī la yaḥ badzra dha rod a dzñā pa ya tiḥ sarba bighnanaḥ kā ya wakka tsittaḥ badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes tshe khrus kyi dgongs pas zan ling bsgral zhing mtshon chas gtub pa ni/ gsod gri thogs la/ hūm̐ḥ sgrol byed ging chen bco brgyad poḥ gshan pa chen po srog gi bdagaḥ rngam chen 'joms pa'i snying rje medaḥ sha khrag drod la rgyug cing rngamaḥ las kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyedaḥ kha rlangs nad kyi 257) dbal du 'charaḥ lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs brnamasaḥ gang la dmigs pa sngon du sgrolaḥ tsitta dang ni nang khrol gtubasaḥ rnam shes bkrag mdangs lus srog dbrolaḥ sha khrag ro la sreg cing zaḥ kha gdangs ljags bsgril mche ba gtsigasaḥ rkang pas rgyug cing lag pas rtseḥ skye 'gro kun gyi srog dbugs lenaḥ kha nas khrag 'dzag myos shing brgyalaḥ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babaḥ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegasaḥ ma lus srog gcod gzir zhing gnonaḥ

sdang dgra gnod byed rdul du rlogasaḥ bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzodaḥ rings par khug la myur du sgrolaḥ zhes dang rtsa sngags mthar / oṃ āḥ.uṣṇi ṣa ya rbadaḥ yan tra tsakra rbadaḥ mant+ra ya tsa ma rbadaḥ bsad sngags btags pa zlo bzhin du liṅga gtubs la/ gtun du rdung ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtunaḥ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnamasaḥ rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nasaḥ lus ngag 258) rdul phran bzhin du rlogasaḥ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung duḥ rdo rje tho bas rdung byas nasaḥ lha yang rung ste brlag par gyuraḥ kha thaṃ kha thaṃḥ nyer gcig brjod bstab pa ni gzhung ltar ram/ hūm̐ḥ dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nasaḥ 'chol ba'i khro rgyal zhal gdongs shigaḥ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegasaḥ zhal du bstabs so khā raṃ khā tiḥ rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥ dgra bgaigs sha ni bza' ba'i mchogaḥ gti mug sha yi mchod pa bzhesaḥ dgra bgegs khrag gi btung ba'i mchogaḥ 'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa bzhesaḥ dgra bgegs rus pa bcud kyi mchogaḥ zhe sdang rus pa'i mchod pa bzhesaḥ dgra bo'i glo snying sman gyi rgyuḥ nga rgyal glo snying mchod pa 'bulaḥ dgra bo'i mkhris pa dza gad rgyuḥ phrag dog mkhris pa'i mchod pa bzhesaḥ 'di ni dug lnga'i mchod pa steḥ dbang drag lha tshogs bzhes su gsolaḥ ma hā maṃ sa la 259) khā hiḥ ma hā rakta la khā hiḥ ma hā tsitta la khā hiḥ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hiḥ ma hā ba su ta la khā hiḥ ma hā king ni ri ti la khā hiḥ zhes ling ro gtor mar bran zhing sman raka gis bran/ chogs lhag bsdus la lhag ma'i mthar dbyung*/ de nas mnan sngags zlo bzhin par ling ga la gsang sngags kyis btags pa'i dug khrag gi khram btab pa laḥ dgra 'dre'i lteb tshul mang yang g.yas kyis g.yon bkab sogs kyis ngag bzhin bltabs nas shi skra dang tshon skud kyis rgya gram du bcing*/ dmigs bsal gyi mnan thod 'byor na rab de min rang rang la rung mthun dang*/

rang gshed dang ldan pa'i snod du gzhug thun rdzas dang*/ sri can la tshwa dang ba tshwa bul tog kyang bsnan pas bar gseng med par bkang ste thal chen gyi gtams pa'am la chas bkag badzra karma ha na ha na badzra badzraḥ zhes rdo rje'i rgya dang bsgrags 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i man ngag las gsungs pa'i dgra dur phung gsum mnan pa khro bo'i dpuu+ung non ni hūm̐ e dzaḥbhrum̐ thugs rje'i 'od rtsal srid gsum gang ba'i tshogasaḥ gcig tu dril ba'i stobs shugs nus pa'i dbalaḥ bgegs srin mthar byed gshin yul 260) e gsang klongaḥ ting 'dzin rdo rje thod pa'i brda ru snangaḥ dbyings rtsal 'gag med bdud 'dul khro bo'i sprinaḥ drag sngags lu gu rgyud kyi thig le yisaḥ nam yang gzhom med rdo rje'i ngo bo ruḥ srid pa spu gri'i 'khor los rgyas thob cigaḥ oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ lam st+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ hā swa ye ṇa ma shra hā maḥ dī ba waṃ eḥ dha ro ni yo tsaḥ ṣāttai da ba hyaḥ te ga thā ta ṣanaḥ te tun te wā pra bha tu he ma dhar me oṃḥ zhes rten 'brel nag pos rab tu gnas/ phung re dang byad thag gis bcings la rtsang rgya gram du gzer te lag tshags dam par bya'o// de'ang skabs 'di'am long khyab dang bstun pa'i gang bya ba'i sa phyogs rung mthun dmigs bsal sogs kyis der bskyod la/ gser skyems dang dgos pa'i yo byad 'du byas nas/ sa bdag lto phye'i thig rtsa rang lugs phra zhib kyi lag len ltar ram/ yang na lta ba rgyas thebs nges pa'i rnal 'byor pas chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig par thag chod pa'i chos la brtan pos st+wa re 'jor sogs sgo byed kyi lag char khro bo'i sngags kyis ngar btab pas sa dmigs dong tshad sogs gsang sngags kyi gzhung chen po nas gsungs pa'i nges pa bzhin mdzad pa las/ brkyang 261) khru 'dre rkas btsugs pa lta bu'i sa dmigs 'tshol ba lung rigs gnyis kas dben te gsang chen gyi mig ltos la gnod pas dor na legs so//

de ltar legs par grub nas sgo dbye las gzhung gi bskul dang chad tho sogs spyi 'gro ltar byas nas/ gong gnon gyi gtor ma mnan chas mi kha'i rdzas thal 'dams sogs khyer nas mnan par bslebs pa dang*/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos theb phyogs dang mthun par 'dug ste gnas yul gzhis bdag pau lo zla zhag dus la dbang ba'i rigs la gser skyems bshams la rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud sogs kyis phul la bka' bsgo/ de nas sgrub rten gyi ral gri'am phur bu dong khor bsnun la tho chen dgra st+wa bsnun pas sa gzhi gsaḥ mtha' yi rgya mtsho sngo mer gsal bar gyuraḥ de dbus gnam lcags khang pa sgo med nangaḥ las kyi gshin rje nag po ma he'i gdongaḥ gting nas khros pa zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigasaḥ lag g.yas dbyug to g.yon pas sbrul zhags thogasaḥ gcer bu rgyan med ma he'i steng na 'gyingaḥ gshin rje'i 'khor tshogs rngam pa'i tshul gyis bskoraḥ mngon sum 262) lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyuraḥ

ces gsal gdab/ de nas skul pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi naḥ rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nasaḥ srog la rngam pa'i gshin rje niḥ nag po ma he'i gdan stengs suḥ ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa niḥ mi mgos mtshan pa las byung baḥ gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdongaḥ za byed zhal gdangs che ba gtsigasaḥ khros pa'i spyan gsum dmar po 'khrugaḥ skra med sma ra gyen du brdzesaḥ lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'chingaḥ lag g.yas dbyug tos rdul du rlogaḥ chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje gshedaḥ ma mo chen mo tsa munt+riḥ bran dang bcas pa'i dus la babaḥ sha chen khrag zhag rgya mtsho yiḥ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ rgyal bas bsgos pa'i bka' bzhin duḥ snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrolaḥ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegasaḥ zungs shig chings zhig rnams par sdomasaḥ 263) ༄༅/ khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdusaḥ sod cig sgrol cig rengs par gyisaḥ phyes shig mnon cig rmugs par gyisaḥ thul cig choms shig rnam par chingasaḥ rdul cha tsam yang med par gyisaḥ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubasaḥ dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa la/ na mo rtsa rgyud sogs 'gugs gzhug gang rung mthar/ oṃ e ra li hring hring dzaḥ brjod cing*/ dam rdzas mthun pa'i gtor ma 'di rnams laḥ bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo dngaḥ bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po pho mo rnamasaḥ lus ngag yid gsum ldang du med par nonaḥ rig sngags drag pos grol ba med par chingasaḥ byas pa'i las dang nus mthu gtan nas sodaḥ rtag tu thar pa med pa'i gnas su chugasaḥ ces dmar gtor dong nang du 'bul/ de nas mnan chas la dmigs te/ na moḥ rtsa rgyud bla ma sogs 'gugs gzhug drag po'i mthar/ hūm̐ḥ sems can las ngan sdig can khyodaḥ gtad do gshin rje'i lag tu gtadaḥ bcings so 264) rgya mtsho'i gting du bcings: mnan no ri rab 'og tu mnanaḥ sbyangs so 'byung ba bzhi la sbyangasaḥ

sbas sau klu rgyal snying la sbasaḥ 'di las 'da' bar ma byed cigaḥ bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog par sems / hūm̐ḥ dam nyams dgra bo las ngan khyodaḥ khyod mdang sum mdang gi rmi lam naḥ rmi lam mi bzang rmi lam nganaḥ steng nas 'brug sgra ldir ba rmisaḥ dung khang nang du nyal ba rmisaḥ lus la 'ja' tshon gyon pa rmisaḥ 'og tu rta sngon bzhon pa rmisaḥ bar na glog ltar 'khyugs pa rmisaḥ steng nas dung char babs pa rmisaḥ gos nag lus la gyon pa rmisaḥ snying la 'od zer phog pa rmisaḥ lam rogs dmag mis byed pa rmisaḥ hūm̐ḥ da nyon cig sdig can las ngan khyodaḥ steng du 'brug sgra ldir ba ni: sngags 'chang nga yi sngags sgra yinaḥ bar snang glog ltar 'khyug pa ni: sngags lce glog ltar 'khyug pa yinaḥ dung gi char ba 'bab pa ni: yungs dkar 265) thun gyis brab pa yinaḥ dung khang nang du nyal ba niḥ thod sgang skya mo'i nang du tshud pa yinaḥ 'ja' tshon lus la gyon pa de: bal tshon sna lngas bsdams pa yinaḥ 'og rta sngon po zhon pa deḥ 'gal ba'i rta la zhon pa yinaḥ lus la gos nag gyon pa deḥ ro ras nag pos btums pa yinaḥ snying la 'od zer phog pa deḥ lha srung rdzu 'phrul phog pa yinaḥ lam rogs dmag mis byed pa deḥ nga yi gshan pa brgyugs pa yinaḥ dam nyams dgra 'dre byur gsum khyod: khyod mnan rtags 'chi rtags thams cad sharaḥ sdig can bya ba'i mnar med khyodaḥ lus ngag yid gsum st+wam bha ya nanaḥ zhes dang sri can dkyus la / hūm̐ḥ skyes pa pho sri gang nas ldangaḥ pho sri gangs dkar stengs nas langasaḥ rju ba g.yag pho dkar por rdzuḥ g.yag pho rog po'i thod pa ruḥ gangs dkar stongs su pho sri mnanaḥ 266) mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhigaḥ hūm̐ḥ mo sri langs pa gang nas langasaḥ mo sri rgya mtsho'i gting nas langasaḥ rju ba khyi mo nag mor rdzuḥ khyi mo nag mo'i thod pa ruḥ rgya mtsho'i gting du mo sri mnanaḥ mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhigaḥ hūm̐ḥ chung sri langs pa gang nas langasaḥ

chung sri nyal pa'i 'og nas langasaḥ rju ba khyi gu phru gur rdzuḥ khyi gu phru gu'i thod pa ruḥ chung sri nyal pa'i 'og tu mnanaḥ mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhigaḥ hūm̐ḥ dgra sri langs pa gang nas langasaḥ dgra sri la rdzas 'og nas langs: rju ba spyang ki sngon por rdzuḥ spyang ki sngon po'i thod pa ruḥ dgra sri la rdzas 'og tu mnanaḥ mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhigaḥ hūm̐ḥ phyugs sri god sri gang nas langasaḥ phyugs sri rwa ba'i dkyil nas langasaḥ rdzu ba 'bri mo rog mor rdzuḥ sems can gang shi'i thod pa ruḥ phyugs sri rwa ba'i 267) dkyil du mnanaḥ mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhigaḥ dgra bo 'phyo zhing smyo ru chugasaḥ dam nyams dgra bgegs byur gsum mnanaḥ st+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ zhes brjod cing ling ga mnan dong du kha phyogs ma 'chor bar sgyur/ ji bzhin bsdad na las 'grub po/ dmigs bya khong chud gshin rje'i zhal bsdams te: mnan pa'i las sbyar dam nyams ru tra 'diḥ bskal pa ma stongs bar du mi thar bsaḥ mun nag rum gyi nang nas rgya mtsho'i gtingaḥ rim bdun sa 'og gshin rje'i grong du songaḥ zhes mi kha'i rdzas rnams blugs/ dur g.yam la stong khams dang rgya gram bris pas bkan/ thal 'dam gyis lcibs la khro chus bsdams par bsams/ lo dang zla ba la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ zhag dang za ma la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ srog lus dbang thang la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ rlung rta dang sme ba la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ khrom la 'debs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ mgo thog nas ri las lji dpa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ rkang 'og 268) nas tsher ma las rtsub pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ phyi dgra med ltar 'bar byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ nang dgra rlung ltar 'tshub par byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ rgyab nas 'dod pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubs:

mdun nas sgug pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ bzang dgra gong nas sdig pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ ngan dgra 'og nas 'jab pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ lus la sbrul ltar 'khril ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ klad nas rbab ltar 'dril ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ zhabs su dong ltar 'dru ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ long ba brgya yi mi kha zug pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ ngan pa stong gi bra mchu zug pa thams cad nan chings brubaḥsnga dgra lag gis rdar ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ phyi dgra yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ da dgra mdun nas shom pa'i dgra bo 269) thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ mdun nas khyi ltar zug pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ logs nas spyang ltar 'jab pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ gzugs can dgra bo'i dmag dpung thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ gzugs med lha 'dre'i za kha gtod pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ 'byung bzhi'i dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ skyes pa pho brgya'i mda' gral du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ za ma mo brgya'i 'phang ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ byis pa chung gi rtse ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ mgar ba'i sol khang du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ mnyan pa'i gru tshugs su gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ mgron po kha dal gyis gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ dgra chags pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ bdud langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ sngags pa'i sgrub khang du gleng ba'i mi kha 270) thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ bon po'i g.yang gral du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ bla ma'i chos rwa na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ btsun pa'i tshogs gral du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ

bu mo'i bro ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ gtso bo'i gros ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ brgya kha mang gis gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasasaḥ stong mig mang gis lta ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ za dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ 'phrog dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ bcom dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ rdung dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ gsod dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ rku dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ nye ba'i dgra shom byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ khyim mtshes kyis rku shom byed pa'i 271) dgra bo thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ skyes pa pho'i pho sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ bud med kyi mo sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ byis pa'i chung sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ rgan po'i rgan sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ gzhon pa'i gzhon sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ dar ma'i dar sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ phung sri god sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brubasaḥ bstan dgra'i lus ngag yid gsum st+wam bha ya nanaḥ zhes thal rdeb bya zhing rnga mas brabaḥ me chu go ldog gi rgya dang sas cung zad g.yogasaḥ de'i steng du tsha tsha nag po gcig bzhag la sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i pho brang btab par bsams la/ ngag tu/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab 'ogaḥ mnan pa yin gyi ldang bar ma byed cigaḥ sangs rgyas don yod grub pas rgyas btab poḥ dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su sa ma dhiḥ zhes rjod/ sa rim pa bdun gyis g.yogs/ khod snyoms par byas la rta bro rdung ba ni/ sngags sde las/ mi mthun glu sna blang ba ni las 'jug 272) bro yis bsdu ba yinaḥ zhes gsungs pa bzhin mched lcam rnams mthe'u chung sbrel/

bro ra gru gsum du bcas la khro bo'i stangs stabs dang bcas te/ gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgyaḥ gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab rgyaḥ gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi rgyaḥ bzhi ni phyag rgya bzhi yi rgyaḥ lnga ni ye shes lnga yi rgyaḥ drug ni pha rol phyin drug rgyaḥ bdun ni ma mo bdun gyi rgyaḥ brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad gyi rgyaḥ dgu ni he ru ka klong dgu'i rgyaḥ bcu ni khro rgyal bcu yi rgyaḥ khyod la rgya bcus bcings te gdabaḥ ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnanaḥ dpa' bo'i bro gar bcas te rdungaḥ bskal pa ji snyed mtha' ru mnanaḥ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ zhes bro rdungs de rjes gong non gtor ma/ dzaḥbhyoḥrbadaḥ bhyoḥ do nub drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs paḥ sogs gzhung gzhin phongs brtan ma skyongs/ spro na gtor gzhog mnan steng du kha sbubs la/ hūm̐ sumbha ni 'i mthar hūm̐ḥ e yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sogs brjod mthar mnan bya gnaun byed thams cad gsal stong 'dzin med 273) ngang la dar gcig mnyam par 'jog pa ni don dam pa'i mnan pa ste tshegs chung la don che ba zhig go rgyud gzhan dang mkhas pa'i man ngag tu dar la phyir mi zlog pa'i gnad 'gag gsungs pa'ang skabs 'di nyid du dran par bya/ spyi chings la dgra bgegs zhi ba'i mi rtags ldan na/ bshags shing gso ba'i cho ga dang*/ tshe chog dag la 'bad par bya/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin nang du log nas tshe 'gugs gtang rag nongs bshags sogs bya ba yang gnad 'gag go / 'dir smras pa/ rab 'bar 'jigs byed rdo rje drag po rtsal// rab tu khros pa 'chol ba'i khro rgyal gyi// rab 'byams las bzhi'i phrin las na kra'i grong*// rab mang mtha' dbus gting mtha' med pa nas// mngon spyod dmod pa'i mtha' sdud rlung la bskur// bud shing bya dang rgya mtsho sba ba las// 'di ni phyi ma'i bzhed gzhung mnan pa'i khrid// gab dkrugs dgongs don snying por te bkod// de dus bskyed rdzogs man ngag gzhung don las/

kham re'i zas la 'dem pa'i gnas skabs su// 'di 'dra gdengs can mdun sar gla rtsi bzhin// phyogs lhung tshig gis zug ngus gnod las ci// 'on te skal mnyam 'ga' yis bskul 'debs dang*// gter chos 'di la bdag gir byed pa'i slad// rma med lhag bsam dag pas nyer bsgrubs las// nongs pa mchis na snying nas lha la bshags// gal te tshig 274) shar klog pa tsam la yang*// ro 'dzin mdud pa'i rgyar chu skye bo yis// sgros ngan khwa ta'i log sgras mgrin pa 'degs// de ni snying rje'i gzhi las do zla min// zhes mnan pa'i las khrigs ri rab nag po zhes bya ba wa gand+ri dharma kirti sogs don gnyer can 'ga' dang rang la mkho phyir gzhung gi dgongs don gtsor bzung*/ khog dbubs kyi sngags 'ga' zhig gis zur brgyan/ 'gugs 'dren sogs kyi 'don cha byang bdag rig 'dzin dbang po'i sde'i ljags bsgrigs la skabs babs kyi sgyur kha bag tsam re byas te zab chos 'di nyid kyi bka' babs gter chen bla ma dam pa nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen bai ro gnyis pa rnga yab gling du gshegs nas bgrang bya rigs byed klu gzugs bslebs pa 'dzin byed ces pa med pho byi ba'i lo dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyi stong pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dmag dpon chu ltar 'gyogs 'gros rtsom pa'i dus tshes rtsub mor rig pa 'dzin pa dbang chen mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis spel ba bstan dgra gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i rdo rje'i gsung la kha bsgyur ba'ang dpal chen 'dus pas so//
